name: Team Fortress 2
short_description: Nine cartoon classes fight over control points and carts.
sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: Nine cartoon classes fight over control points and carts.

identity.core_loop: Pick a class, push or defend the objective, swap class to counter.
identity.ui_and_game_feel: Readable silhouettes, comic timing, huge personality.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: Team colours and class shapes tell you everything at a glance; the objective is a cart you can see.

rendering.signature: Half-Lambert lighting looked up through a hand-made warm ramp, plus a strong rim, so forms read like a 1960s illustration.
rendering.source: oracle rendering study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no captures, no game files)
rendering.lesson: Own the light ramp: it is the cheapest, most powerful art-direction control in a toon shader.

identity.audio_mood: Brassy spy themes and voice barks.
identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: Silhouette is information: each role readable from across the map.

review: Still the gold standard for character readability. Nine shapes, nine jobs, and you know which is which from 100 metres. Abbie's World animals should read that clearly.
